content:
Asha (AE): Hey team — prepping POC for Acme Corp (large enterprise). Need an internal checklist + runbook for provisioning their POC environment. They want to start on Hosted API but will probably ask about Dedicated pools and Private/VPC later. Who can share a step-by-step we can follow and the typical lead times?

Tom (Solutions Eng): +1. I'll sketch a concise runbook for three paths: Hosted API (fastest), Dedicated (reserved GPU pool), Private/VPC (onboarding + network). Tagging @Priya and @Jordan for infra specifics.

Priya (Platform Eng): Hosted API — quick checklist:
- Create customer project in Console.
- Generate scoped API key (name: `acme-poc-hosted`). Minimum scopes: `inference:request`, `inference:metrics`.
- Apply soft quotas: e.g. token cap 50k/day and rate limit 10 req/s for POC.
- Enable streaming if demo needs low-latency UX.
- Create demo service account and add to team for audit trails.
- Share key via secure vault (1Password/SecretsManager link) and send access approval email.

Sample cURL to create key (admin token required):
```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \ 
  -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/keys \ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  -d '{"name":"acme-poc-hosted","scopes":["inference:request","inference:metrics"],"quotas":{"tokens_per_day":50000}}'
```

Tom (Solutions Eng): Add to that: Create a minimal prompt set and evaluation harness so we can monitor quality regressions during POC. Hook Redwood Optimize to capture token/cost metrics.

Jordan (Infra): Dedicated pool checklist (short):
- SalesOps opens Dedicated request ticket with: expected concurrent RPS, peak seq length, latency SLO, preferred region/GPU (A100/H100), start date, and duration.
- Infra creates pool with labels `customer:acme, env:poc, owner:tom`.
- Configure autoscaling: min 1, max 4 nodes for POC.
- Network: ensure ingress CIDR for customer IPs and Redwood control-plane egress allowed.
- Billing: tag resources for chargeback and attach reserved capacity SKU.
- Lead time: 3-5 business days for standard pools; 7-10 if special hardware/region.

Jordan (Infra): Sample request form fields to paste into ticket:
```
Customer: Acme Corp
POC start: 2025-12-01
Region: us-west-2
GPU: 1 x A100-40GB/node
Min instances: 1
Max instances: 4
Latency SLO: 200ms p95
Expected queries/sec: 15
Peak sequence length: 1024
VPC peering required: no (for Dedicated)
```

InfraBot: Ticket created: #DPOOL-4127 assigned to @Jordan. ETA: 4 business days. :gear: :alarm_clock:

Elaine (SalesOps): Pricing / commercial notes for POC:
- Offer one month of 50% usage discount or $5k credit (whichever smaller) for enterprise POC.
- For Dedicated, include a short-term commitment addendum (30 days) to reserve capacity.
- Add clause in SOW: performance SLAs not binding for POC, full SLA upon Dedicated conversion.

Asha (AE): Important: Acme will want answers for the security questionnaire before any keys are shared. What are the must-have items we can provide quickly?

Tom (Solutions Eng): Security quick answers for POC:
- Data handling: Hosted API — customer data is isolated per project; we retain logs for 30 days by default but can change retention per request.
- Encryption: In transit TLS 1.2+, at-rest AES-256. KMS integration available for Dedicated/Private.
- Auth: API keys for Hosted; SSO/SAML + SCIM provisioning for Dedicated/Private.
- Access controls: scoped API keys + least-privilege service accounts.
- Auditing: request/response hashes, request metadata, and operator audit logs (retain 90 days by default for enterprise).
- Compliance: SOC2 Type II evidence available; we can start an evidence share for security folks.

Priya (Platform Eng): Private/VPC setup checklist (network/security heavy):
- Preliminary: collect customer's VPC CIDR, peering or transit gateway preference, required egress endpoints, and IP allowlist.
- Create Private deployment request: includes desired control plane placement (managed vs customer-managed), KMS key ID if BYOK, and HSM requirement.
- Network tasks: configure VPC peering or PrivateLink, update route tables, NAT/egress rules to allow model downloads and metrics export to our monitoring endpoints.
- Security hardening: disable public egress except approved endpoints, set up mTLS between customer and runtime plane, verify ports: allow 443 and internal gRPC ports only.
- Lead time: 2-4 weeks for standard Private deployment; 4-8 weeks if customer requires on-prem air-gapped installation.

Tom (Solutions Eng): Example network note to give customer: "We will request peering and a set of /28 IPs for control-plane health checks. Traffic for model updates will originate from 54.23.45.67/32 and must be reachable." (replace with current IPs from infra).

Elaine (SalesOps): Security questionnaire logistics: gather answers to the top 20 security questions, prepare a short slide deck, and schedule a 30-min security review call between Acme's SecOps and our security engineer. Make evidence pack (SOC2, pen test summary) available via secure link.

Asha (AE): Any gotchas or common enterprise blockers we should pre-empt?

Jordan (Infra): Common blockers:
- Customer requires dedicated KMS/HSM and cannot use cloud KMS -> extra procurement and network hurdles.
- Strict IP allowlists that block control-plane health checks -> need NAT or proxy.
- Corporate procurement delays for MSA/SOW.

Tom (Solutions Eng): Also watch for model governance questions: if customer wants model weights removed post-POC or no-model-hosting, note we can propose ephemeral deployments and purge caches/logs on termination.

Elaine (SalesOps): For billing: ensure we create a temporary billing account and tag usage to the deal. SalesOps will provision a promo code or credit and ensure invoices are routed to the correct AR contact.

Asha (AE): Awesome — I'm going to: 1) request Hosted API key with quotas, 2) open Dedicated ticket for backup, 3) start security evidence pack request. Posting checklist to the customer tomorrow.

Tom (Solutions Eng): I'll assemble the short prompt eval and the Optimize dashboard template for the POC.

Priya (Platform Eng): I'll queue the Private/VPC intake doc template and send network field list.

InfraBot: Reminder: add `poc:onboarding` label to all tickets for reporting.

Asha (AE): Thanks everyone. I'll update this thread with the customer kickoff date and attach the initial SOW once I have it. :thumbsup:
